# Lab 1.1: Set Up Your BigQuery Lab Project

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a project for the course, link billing, set a budget, enable the BigQuery APIs, and tour the BigQuery navigation menu.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Create a project.** Go to **IAM & Admin → Manage resources → Create project**. Name it `bq-course-lab` and click **Create**. Then go to **Billing → Link a billing account** and choose your billing account.

2. **[CLI] Open Cloud Shell and point it at the project.** Click the **Activate Cloud Shell** icon at the top right.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">export PROJECT_ID=$(gcloud projects list --filter="name:bq-course-lab" --format="value(projectId)")
gcloud config set project $PROJECT_ID
gcloud billing projects describe $PROJECT_ID --format="value(billingEnabled)"
echo "export PROJECT_ID=$PROJECT_ID" &gt;&gt; ~/.bashrc</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The billing check must print `True`. The last line keeps `$PROJECT_ID` for every future Cloud Shell session.

3. **[CLI] Enable the APIs used in this course.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable bigquery.googleapis.com bigquerystorage.googleapis.com \
  bigqueryconnection.googleapis.com bigquerydatatransfer.googleapis.com \
  bigquerydatapolicy.googleapis.com bigquerymigration.googleapis.com \
  dataform.googleapis.com aiplatform.googleapis.com
gcloud services list --enabled --filter="name~bigquery OR name~dataform OR name~aiplatform"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Set a budget so the labs stay cheap.** Go to **Billing → Budgets & alerts → Create budget**. Scope it to `bq-course-lab`, set the amount to **10** in your currency, and keep alerts at **50%, 90%, 100%**.

5. **[Console] Tour BigQuery.** Open **Navigation menu → BigQuery** and pin it. Walk through each menu item: **Studio, Agents, Pipelines and connections, Dataform**, then **Governance** (Sharing, Security centre, Metadata curation), **Administration** (Monitoring, Jobs explorer, Workload management, BI Engine, Disaster recovery, Recommendations), **Migration** and **Partner Centre**.

6. **[CLI] Confirm BigQuery works.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq ls
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT "Hello BigQuery" AS greeting'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   `bq ls` prints nothing yet because the project has no datasets.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Project | `bq-course-lab` with billing linked |
| APIs | BigQuery, Storage, Connection, Transfer, Data Policy, Migration, Dataform, Vertex AI enabled |
| Budget | Alerts at 50%, 90% and 100% |
| First query | Returns `Hello BigQuery` |
